verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a one-line install (curl install.sh), launching the agent with `cd your-project; claude`, terminal-first operation across macOS, Linux and Windows, and editing files and running commands from the terminal. Hands-on community reports of daily terminal use and its bash-tool design corroborate this. One user reported an unresponsive terminal, an isolated anecdote rather than a concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: evidence that execution is fully local (it requires a Claude.ai login or Anthropic API key and has no documented offline/local-model mode), and that isolated unresponsive-terminal report remains unaddressed.
